programmes.d: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by Portugal, Argentina, India, and Japan.
Host Vijaya Selvaraju makes delectable Indian dishes using versatile Indian spices and flavors.
Chef Spencer Watts demonstrates how to make an Indian feast for the whole family.
Four chefs tackle dessert starting with a classic Carrot Cake.
Chef Vijaya Selvaraju makes dal soup, fish in a red chili chutney and coconut barfi for dessert.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: My Thali by Joe Thottungal; follow along as Shahir prepares goat curry, fried tilapia, pork and potato masala, and much more.
Chef Vijaya prepares a mango lassi drink, pickled mangoes, mango chutney and lamb chops two ways.

Spencer prepares a full, family-style Indian meal.
